<h1>Blog</h1>
<p class="lede">I write about what I am learning and teaching. My main project here is a tutorial series on generative models, from autoregressive models and VAEs to energy-based, score-based, diffusion, and flow-matching models. This page also collects the software and research projects I have worked on.</p>
:::

::: {.card-grid}
::: {.card}
<span class="meta">Tutorial · Aug 2025</span>
<h3><a href="https://github.com/Aref-Shahbakhsh/Neural-Generative-Auto-Regressive-Gussian-mixture">Neural autoregressive model with Gaussian mixture</a></h3>
<p>An implementation of a neural autoregressive model, the foundation behind models like ChatGPT, that uses a Gaussian mixture for each conditional probability. Code and walkthrough on GitHub.</p>
:::
::: {.card}
<span class="meta">Tutorial · Apr 2025</span>
<h3>Variational autoencoders: basic concepts and foundations</h3>
<p>Starts from compression and the encoder q(Z|X) and decoder P(X|Z), explains why the posterior is intractable, and sets up variational inference. The variational inference part is still to come.</p>
:::
:::
